verses.1: For you shall sit in judgment over those who are before you.
verses.2: And you have placed shackles upon them in your grasp. Are you indeed a man of great spirit?
verses.3: Do not listen to his arguments; he is like a liar.
verses.4: Do not try to become rich through your own efforts.
verses.5: Look upon him, and do not be afraid. For he will do what is right, just as wings that spread out can carry heavy burdens.
verses.6: Do not fight with evil people; do not submit to their demands.
verses.7: For just as a door is in one’s mind, so too does he eat and drink. It says to you, “And his heart is with you.”
verses.8: You have eaten bitterness and vomited out your pleasant words.
verses.9: In the ears of the fool, do not speak, for his mind will be filled with nonsense.
verses.10: Do not cross the boundaries of the world, nor enter the depths of darkness. Do not come near.
verses.11: For he is a strong warrior who will fight against their enemies together with you.
verses.12: She brought your heart and your ears to listen to the words of wisdom.
verses.13: Do not delay sending a young man to be appointed as a leader, so that he may not die.
verses.14: You are in the midst of planning, but his soul is willing to endure.
verses.15: Son, if your heart is wise, then my heart will also rejoice.
verses.16: And I will make all my enemies tremble at the sound of your words.
verses.17: Do not be concerned about your sins, but always regard Jehovah with fear.
verses.18: For if there is a younger sister, and your request does not get fulfilled.
verses.19: Hear, my son, be wise and follow the path that is right for you.
verses.20: Let there be no such things as “Sobey-Yayin” in the midst of those evil people.
verses.21: For Soba and Zolel will inherit, and they will wear torn clothes.
verses.22: Listen to your father, this child of yours. Do not be like your mother, who is old and no longer able to help you.
verses.23: Truth is worth buying and selling; wisdom, knowledge, and understanding should not be traded.
verses.24: May Gil Yagil be a righteous father, and may he live a wise life. May he rejoice in that.
verses.25: Rejoice, your father and mother! Your birth will be a source of joy for you.
verses.26: “Set your heart upon me, my son; and let your eyes follow my ways.”
verses.27: This barren and desolate land is full of wild animals.
verses.28: Even she, as a woman, will be deceived and misled by men.
verses.29: To whom, oh Lord? To whom, my father? To whom shall I give them? To whom shall I heal their wounds? To whom shall I restore their sight?
verses.30: For those who come to study from the store.
verses.31: Do not be deceived; when a man is given a sack, his eyes will still see clearly. He will walk among the righteous.
verses.32: Afterward, like a serpent, it will spread out; and like a spider, it will spin its web.
verses.33: Your eyes will see things that are strange, and your heart will speak in words of revelation.
verses.34: And you would lie down in the depths of the sea, and also in the depths of the sky.
verses.35: I was sick and in pain. I knew nothing. I would continue to ask for help again and again.
